name: Nebius Group
theme: AI cloud + GPU infrastructure + data-centre capacity
thesis: Nebius is a high-growth AI infrastructure platform with direct exposure to GPU cloud demand and data-centre capacity expansion. The upside is substantial if customer commitments convert into durable revenue and margins, but the investment case now depends just as heavily on capital efficiency, financing structure and execution as on demand growth.
catalysts: Capacity additions, conversion of customer commitments into revenue, stronger AI-cloud utilisation, margin scaling, large enterprise/hyperscaler contracts and evidence that returns on new data-centre capex exceed the cost of capital.
risks: Very high AI-cycle dependency, aggressive capex, financing/dilution risk, roughly $12bn of convertible debt after the latest deal, valuation sensitivity, customer concentration and the possibility that industry capacity growth outruns end demand.
valuationTechnical: The supplied August 20 chart placed NBIS near lower-channel support in the low-$220s. Reuters reported shares around $220.10 on August 20 after further pressure from financing and dilution. The technical level is attractive only if the capital-structure risk is accepted; prefer scaling and confirmation above roughly $230-$235 rather than assuming the channel must hold.
researchNote: The $5bn convertible bond sale, upsized from $4.5bn and potentially expandable to $5.75bn, is both a bullish demand signal and a material equity-risk warning. Q2 sales rose fivefold to $582m, but the company lost $190m and spent $5.7bn on capex in the quarter. A separate $800m convertible swap into 15.8m shares represented about 5.5% dilution. Conviction stays 7.6 rather than rising on the pullback: demand is exceptional, but capital intensity and future dilution are now the main gating variables.
whatMarketsWillWatch: Whether lower-channel support around the low-$220s holds
Capex intensity versus revenue and EBITDA scaling
Further dilution or leverage after the latest convertible financing
Whether price can reclaim the roughly $230-$235 area after the pullback
